newsitem.title: POLAND: Bank consortium lends Kredyt Bank $26 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bank consortium lends Kredyt Bank $26 mln.

text.p: Polish bank Kredyt Bank SA signed an agreement with a credit consortium to receive $26 million in loans, the bank's spokeswoman said on Thursday.
"The loan is for investment and for issuing credit, mainly long-term foreign-currency credit," Malgorzata Szelewicka told Reuters.
The organizer of the consortium is Britain's West Merchant Bank, the agent is Chase Manhattan Bank, and 11 other West European banks are taking part.
The annual interest on the loan, which must be paid back by September 1999, is based on the three-month LIBOR plus 80 basis points.
